doc.description: Digital camera control using radio channel. A valid RC channel above 3000 triggers immediately, then once per second while held high. Releasing the switch or losing RC stops RC-triggered shots. Valid RC returning with the switch high resumes shooting immediately. The switch is sampled at 4 Hz and works independently of autopilot mode. It sends generic DC_SHOOT commands without changing autonomous autoshoot; switching low does not cancel flight-plan or GCS photography.

define.name: DC_RADIO_SHOOT
define.description: specifies the channel to be used to trigger the camera by radio transmiter
